svg.title: Atari 5-task continual RL: min-max consolidation vs CLEAR
svg.text: CLEAR's retention, without CLEAR's replay buffer
5 Atari games in sequence · normalized score, random = 0, threshold = 1 · 2 seeds
Read down a column. Outlined cell = the moment that game was learned.
A constraint retains as well as a replay buffer.
What is left to close is raw score, not memory.
